title: Couchbase Document
description: Schema representing a Couchbase document with metadata fields used across Server, Sync Gateway, and Capella APIs.

_id.description: Unique document identifier within the bucket or collection

_rev.description: Revision identifier in Sync Gateway format (generation-digest)

_deleted.description: Indicates whether the document is a deletion tombstone

_exp.description: Document expiration time as a Unix timestamp in seconds (0 means no expiry)

_attachments.description: Map of attachment names to attachment metadata

_sync.description: Sync Gateway metadata (internal, not typically user-facing)

access.description: User access grants from this document

role_access.description: Role access grants from this document

digest.description: Content digest hash of the attachment

length.description: Size of the attachment in bytes

revpos.description: Revision generation when the attachment was added

stub.description: Whether this is a stub reference (true) or contains inline data (false)

data.description: Base64-encoded attachment data (only present when not a stub)
